content:
The task was successfully completed using dynamic INDEX/MATCH lookups and weighted mean calculations to ensure data integrity across sheets.
The planner utilized INDEX/MATCH formulas to dynamically locate series codes and year headers on the 'Data' sheet, avoiding hardcoded cell references. Weighted means were calculated using SUMPRODUCT/SUM based on 'Compute Capacity' weights and 'Net reliability gap' values. Robustness was ensured by balancing absolute and relative references ($D12, H$10) and verifying summary statistic labels like MIN and MAX before formula application.
